title: Storey Architecture media frame
description: A square-cornered image frame at a given aspect ratio. As it enters the window a black veil over it fades away; while it crosses the window the (oversized) media inside drifts down, a slow parallax. On hover a small white label follows the pointer.
notes: the veil is drawn with bg-foreground, so on dark themes it reads as a pale wash
empty media shows a bg-muted placeholder; pass an with object-cover to fill it
the label follows the pointer once hydrated; without JavaScript it appears at the top-left on hover
